WorkspaceSettings.title: WorkspaceSettings
WorkspaceSettings.description: Configurable business branding, header titles, and industry preset for the manufacturing workspace.

brandName.description: Brand or company wordmark shown in the top bar.

workspaceTitle.description: Main configurable application heading shown on the overview dashboard.

workspaceSubtitle.description: Configurable descriptive subtitle explaining the business operations.

industryLabel.description: Industry or business category kicker label.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were last updated.

RawMaterial.title: RawMaterial
RawMaterial.description: Raw ingredient, material, component, chemical, or packaging item used in product manufacturing.

ownerId.description: UID of the business owner who manages this raw material.

name.description: Name of the raw material or ingredient.

sku.description: Internal stock keeping code for the raw material.

unit.description: Base measurement unit for inventory tracking and recipe costing.

stockQuantity.description: Current available physical stock quantity in the base unit.

reorderPoint.description: Minimum stock level before triggering a low-stock restock alert.

costPerUnit.description: Weighted average or latest purchase cost per single base unit.

notes.description: Storage handling notes or specification details.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the raw material record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the raw material record was last updated.

PurchaseOrder.title: PurchaseOrder
PurchaseOrder.description: Record of raw material procurement that replenishes stock and updates weighted unit cost.

ownerId.description: UID of the business owner who logged this purchase.

materialId.description: Document ID of the associated RawMaterial.

materialName.description: Snapshot name of the raw material purchased.

supplierName.description: Supplier or distributor for this purchase.

quantityPurchased.description: Quantity received in the material's base unit.

unit.description: Base measurement unit of the material.

unitCost.description: Purchase price per single base unit for this delivery.

totalCost.description: Total expenditure for this purchase order.

batchReference.description: Supplier invoice number or lot code.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the purchase was recorded.

Formula.title: Formula
Formula.description: Master formulation or recipe for a finished product.

batchYieldUnits.description: Number of finished sellable units produced per 1x standard batch.

unitLabel.description: Packaging format of a single finished unit (e.g., 1L Bottle, 250g Jar, 12oz Bag).

laborCostPerBatch.description: Direct production and packaging labor cost per standard batch.

overheadCostPerBatch.description: Utilities, equipment, and quality control overhead per standard batch.

sellingPricePerUnit.description: Target wholesale or retail selling price per finished unit.

finishedStockUnits.description: Current inventory of finished product units available for sale.

targetMarginPercent.description: Target gross profit margin percentage for pricing benchmarks.

notes.description: Production procedure, quality specs, or assembly instructions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the formula was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the formula was last updated.

FormulaIngredient.title: FormulaIngredient
FormulaIngredient.description: Relational line item linking a Formula to a required RawMaterial and dosage quantity per standard batch.

formulaId.description: Document ID of the parent Formula.

materialId.description: Document ID of the required RawMaterial.

materialName.description: Display name of the raw material.

quantityRequired.description: Quantity of the raw material required for a 1x standard batch.

unit.description: Measurement unit matching the raw material.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the ingredient line was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the ingredient line was updated.

ProductionBatch.title: ProductionBatch
ProductionBatch.description: Executed production run that consumes raw materials, increments finished goods, and locks historical cost and profit margin metrics.

formulaId.description: Document ID of the Formula used for this batch.

formulaName.description: Snapshot name of the product formula.

batchMultiplier.description: Scale factor applied to the standard formula batch (e.g., 1, 2, 0.5).

unitsProduced.description: Total finished sellable units produced in this batch.

unitLabel.description: Packaging format of the finished units.

rawMaterialCost.description: Total cost of raw materials and packaging consumed in this batch.

laborCost.description: Total direct labor cost allocated to this batch.

overheadCost.description: Total manufacturing overhead allocated to this batch.

totalProductionCost.description: Combined raw material, labor, and overhead cost for the batch.

costPerUnit.description: Calculated all-in manufacturing cost per single finished unit.

sellingPricePerUnit.description: Unit selling price at the time of batch execution.

projectedRevenue.description: Total expected revenue from selling all units in the batch.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the production batch (completed and cancelled are terminal).

notes.description: Quality control observations or batch notes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the batch was started.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the batch was last updated.

ProductSale.title: ProductSale
ProductSale.description: Recorded customer sale or shipment of finished product units that deducts finished stock and logs realized revenue, cost of goods sold, and net profit.

formulaId.description: Document ID of the Formula sold.

formulaName.description: Snapshot name of the product sold.

productCategory.description: Product category of the item sold.

customerName.description: Customer name, store name, or order reference.

quantitySold.description: Number of finished units sold in this transaction.

unitLabel.description: Packaging format of the finished units (e.g., 1L Bottle).

sellingPricePerUnit.description: Actual unit selling price charged to the customer.

costPerUnit.description: Unit manufacturing cost at the time of sale.

totalCost.description: Total manufacturing cost of the units sold (quantitySold * costPerUnit).

totalProfit.description: Total realized profit earned on this sale (totalRevenue - totalCost).

notes.description: Optional payment method, delivery note, or invoice detail.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the sale was recorded.

/workspaceSettings/{settingId}.description: Stores configurable application title, brand wordmark, and industry labels per user.

/rawMaterials/{materialId}.description: Stores raw materials, ingredients, components, and packaging inventory owned by a user.

/purchaseOrders/{purchaseId}.description: Immutable procurement ledger recording raw material restocks and purchase prices.

/formulas/{formulaId}.description: Stores master product formulations/recipes, yield parameters, labor/overhead costs, selling prices, and finished stock.

/formulaIngredients/{ingredientId}.description: Stores individual raw material dosage requirements per product formula.

/productionBatches/{batchId}.description: Stores production batch runs, cost breakdowns, unit economics, and profit margins.

/productSales/{saleId}.description: Stores customer sales transactions, units sold, cash collected, and realized profit.
